findings.title: TLS handshake took 1.8 seconds
findings.explanation: The TLS phase alone took 1842ms, more than 90% of the total request time. The server's certificate chain or cipher negotiation is unusually slow.
findings.suggested_fix: Investigate the server's TLS configuration. Common causes: missing OCSP stapling, an oversized certificate chain, or the server is CPU-bound during handshake.

findings.title: Connection used HTTP/1.1
findings.explanation: The server did not negotiate HTTP/2. Not a problem on its own, but HTTP/2 would reduce per-request connection overhead.
findings.suggested_fix: If the server supports HTTP/2, ensure ALPN advertises h2 in the TLS handshake.
